messages:
deploy-bot: initiating staged rollout v3.5.1 -> 15% (eu-west 60% / ap-south 40%). warming 1 replica/az. changelog: docs/releases/3.5.1.md :rocket:
riley-sre: spotting a small spike in auth-related 429s in ap-south-1 around 11:05 UTC. moving from 0.1% -> 0.9% in 4m. not yet in eu-west.
dave-eng: any recent infra changes in ap-south? I didn't touch routing but there was a config push earlier to auth-cache TTL.
priya-rel: I pushed a minor auth cache TTL tweak this morning to reduce stale sessions. could be related.
tanner-ops: can we throttle ap-south or pin region? We have an international webinar in 25m. need decision in 8.
riley-sre: logs: ```2026-04-02T11:06:12Z WARN authsvc 429 cache_miss user=xyz shard=12 variant=quant```
dave-eng: shard=12 quant variant. hypothesis: cache priming with quant replicas slower under cold start.
priya-rel: two quick options: 1) THROTTLE ap-south to 2% and continue eu-west 15% OR 2) PIN ap-south back to v3.5.0 and continue elsewhere.
linda-pm: prefer targeted pin to avoid customer impact. webinar is EU-focused but APAC users might get poor experience.
tanner-ops: pin seems safer. command: `deploybot pin --region ap-south --version v3.5.0 --reason "auth 429 spike"`
dave-eng: agree with pin. we'll repro on a test shard and patch quant warmup if needed.
priya-rel: applying pin now. pausing ap-south rollout.
deploy-bot: pin applied: ap-south -> v3.5.0. eu-west continuing at 15% with a soft HOLD if 4xx/5xx > 0.5% for 5m. next check in 10m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
riley-sre: running focused telemetry on auth latency and cache hit ratio. will flag if p95>350ms or 4xx > 0.5%.
linda-pm: I'll update comms and postpone APAC push in marketing. thanks team.
dave-eng: spinning up instrumented quant replicas for shard=12 to validate warmup. will post logs.
priya-rel: note saved to release-playbook: "ap-south pinned to v3.5.0 due to auth 429 spike; eu-west left active at 15% with guardrails."
tanner-ops: consensus: PIN ap-south; HOLD rules enabled in eu-west. reconvene in 10. :white_check_mark:
